fields.narrative_intro: *A flustered person and a quizzical person discuss Minecraft agent swarms in a broken-down elevator.*
fields.panel1:
[setup]
FLUSTERED PERSON: "Researchers dropped up to 50 AI agents into Minecraft to build civilization."
fields.panel2:
[build]
QUIZZICAL PERSON: "With fifty minds, surely coordination became effortless."
fields.panel3:
[pivot]
FLUSTERED PERSON: "They formed committees to approve committees, and buildings never got approved."
fields.panel4:
[silent reaction]
[Visual: The two people stare as fifty tiny Minecraft-style agents hold a committee meeting around the elevator's broken repair panel.]
fields.panel5:
[punch]
QUIZZICAL PERSON: "Did they at least construct a government?"
FLUSTERED PERSON: "No—the repair committee is still seeking permission to meet."
fields.panel6:
[button]
[Visual: Outside, a Minecraft villager grips a diamond pickaxe while fifty agents vote on whether he may lift it.]

narrative_summary: Fifty Minecraft agents fail to build civilization but successfully bureaucratize a broken elevator.
rationale: Candidate 2 wins with the strongest concrete Minecraft payoff: agents bureaucratically voting on whether a villager may lift a diamond pickaxe. Its repair-committee callback gives the punchline an earned escalation rather than merely renaming the failure as middle management.
story_title: AI agent swarms in Minecraft fail to build civilization, drown in bureaucracy
